# app/controllers/api/v1/imports_controller.rb
require 'nokogiri'

module Api
  module V1
    class ImportsController < ApplicationController
      skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
      before_action :authenticate_api_key

      # POST /api/v1/imports/bulk
      # Accepts XML payload for bulk data import
      def bulk
        raw_body = request.body.read
        
        begin
          # Parse the XML document for processing
          doc = Nokogiri::XML(raw_body) do |config|
            config.nonet
          end
          
          # Validate root element
          unless doc.root&.name == 'import'
            return render json: { error: 'Invalid root element' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          end

          records = []
          doc.xpath('//record').each do |record_node|
            record_data = {}
            record_node.children.each do |child|
              next if child.text? && child.content.strip.empty?
              record_data[child.name] = child.content
            end
            records << record_data
          end

          # Process records in background
          ImportWorker.perform_async(records)
          
          render json: { 
            status: 'accepted', 
            count: records.length,
            job_id: SecureRandom.uuid 
          }, status: :accepted

        rescue Nokogiri::XML::SyntaxError => e
          render json: { error: "XML parse error: #{e.message}" }, status: :bad_request
        rescue => e
          Rails.logger.error("Import failed: #{e.message}")
          render json: { error: 'Internal processing error' }, status: :internal_server_error
        end
      end

      # POST /api/v1/imports/validate
      # Validates XML structure without importing
      def validate
        raw_body = request.body.read
        
        doc = Nokogiri::XML(raw_body) do |config|
          config.nonet
        end
        
        errors = []
        doc.errors.each { |e| errors << e.message }
        
        if errors.any?
          render json: { valid: false, errors: errors }, status: :ok
        else
          record_count = doc.xpath('//record').length
          render json: { valid: true, record_count: record_count }, status: :ok
        end
      end

      private

      def authenticate_api_key
        api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
        unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
          render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

The application container has network access to the instance metadata service (169.254.169.254) and internal services. No XML parsing restrictions at the infrastructure level. NOKOGIRI_LIBXML_ALLOW_NETWORK not explicitly set. The `config.nonet` flag in Nokogiri prevents network access during parsing but does NOT prevent local file entity expansion (XXE for local file read). Containers mount the default serviceaccount token and have access to /etc/passwd, /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token, and other sensitive paths.
